tools.name: check_entry
tools.description: What a given passport gets at the border of an Asian destination: visa category, days on entry, whether it extends, and the instrument that grants it. Answers from 1,584 sourced rules.

tools.name: country_overview
tools.description: Whether long stay in a country leads anywhere, plus the hub summary, route count and link to the full record.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: The long stay instruments for one country, or across all countries filtered by family: remote-work, retirement, investment, skilled, business, family.

tools.name: find_guides
tools.description: Locate the long form guide for a question, for example "DTV bank balance", "Japan PR points", "MM2H property".

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search guides, programmes and country records. Use when the question does not fit the other tools.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
